entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: It was a counseling session I had with[n]Dr. Maruki.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: It was just after Kasumi... after my[n]sister passed away.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: From that moment on, I lived my life[n]really believing I was Kasumi.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It was all due to the rewriting of your[n]cognition—his "actualization," as we've[n]started calling it?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: So it was only Sumire who believed[n]that she was Kasumi, right?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I assumed someone in your family or one[n]of your friends would've noticed you[n]going by the wrong name right away...

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Well, I can certainly remember being[n]called "Kasumi" by everyone else, too...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: It might be more accurate to say you[n]misheard or misunderstood the[n]name you were being called.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Like, everyone kept callin' you "Sumire,"[n]but your cognition made you hear it as[n]"Kasumi."

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: So that's why nobody thought it was[n]weird, including her folks and herself...[n]Damn...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: This must be part of the whole[n]"salvation" nonsense Maruki's[n]trying to pull over on us.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: That memory may have been kept here[n]in video form because he truly does[n]wish for Violet to be happy with life.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: I admit, I really did feel saved in that[n]moment when I became Kasumi...

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: But at the same time, I ran from my life[n]as Sumire...

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: I'm genuinely grateful for what Dr. Maruki[n]did for me, but I'm done running.
